title: Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2611.30720v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isol

translated_title: 测试量化KV缓存维护：编码布局与历史恢复
translated_abstract: 重复行再选择原始值的方式即使在编码数量相等的情况下，仍会保留依赖布局的漂移。我们测量了在固定量化KV缓存实现中，现有检查何时无法建立保持契约。在四比特HQQ、轴零、十六个周期的设置下，与同形状重新编码相比，配对相对L2的中位数增加为：Qwen3-1.7B为7.22个百分点，SmolLM3-3B为11.59个百分点。匹配的编码状态覆盖每个模型在一个和十六个周期下的十六个共享问题。轴一与保持形状的对照组相匹配；惰性重排保留初始状态。在一个已知输入上，固定更新次数保留了差异；保留组成员则消除了差异。我们的前缀视图扩展通过了当前前缀检查，却在残差容量为4和128的六种模型/编解码器设置中改变了历史状态和下一个logits。公共查找达到了这一边界，包括四个预先提交的项目级新GPU输入之一；固定查询交换隔离了……
tldr: 该论文通过系统性测试揭示，固定量化KV缓存实现中的现有检查无法建立保持契约——编码布局依赖的漂移可使中位数相对L2误差增加7.22至11.59个百分点，且其提出的前缀视图扩展虽能通过当前前缀检查，却会在多种模型/编解码器设置下悄然改变历史状态与下一个token的logits。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically tests fixed quantized KV-cache implementations and reveals that existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts—layout-dependent drift causes median paired relative-L2 increases of 7.22–11.59 percentage points, and a prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet silently alters history and next-token logits across six model/codec settings.
